candidate: DC BLOX Greenville data center (GVL), 33 Global Drive, Global Business Park, Greenville, Greenville County, South Carolina (existing Tier III colocation facility; ribbon cutting 12 April 2022)
decision: Selected the centroid of City of Greenville tax parcel M011010100337 (situs 33 GLOBAL, owner of record DC BLOX INC), as published in the City of Greenville AddressSearch/Property map service, as the campus locator.
selected_point_role: Area centroid of the single-ring parcel polygon of City of Greenville tax parcel M011010100337 (8.38 geodesic acres), owned of record by DC BLOX INC. It locates the DC BLOX-owned property at 33 Global Drive, not a building footprint or surveyed boundary.

source.layer: City of Greenville, SC AddressSearch/Property MapServer layer 3 'Parcels with Ownership'

native_crosscheck.note: Parcel polygon M011010100337 retrieved twice from the same City of Greenville layer: once reprojected by the server to WGS 84 (outSR=4326) and once in the native CRS (WKID 3361, NAD83(HARN) / South Carolina, US feet; the service notes that its data are WKID 6570 published as the prior WKID 3361).

computed.method: shapely 2.1.1 centroid of the WGS 84 ring; pyproj 3.7.1 Geod(WGS84) area and distances

city_building_footprint.note: The two other footprints returned within 150 m of the address point lie wholly outside the parcel.

global_drive_parcel_list.reading: Eight City parcels carry LOCATE GLOBAL; only M011010100337 (33) is owned by DC BLOX INC. 78 GLOBAL (M011010100344) is owned of record by DARTPOINTS OPRATING COMPANY LL (sic) and is a different property.

parcel_containing_it.reading: M011010100354 (no situs address, 9.86 acres, organisation owner FAIR FOREST OF GREENVILLE LLC, deed 2003), the neighbouring parcel

operator_coordinate.note: DC BLOX publishes the pair in schema.org GeoCoordinates (identical in the Internet Archive copy of 14 September 2026). It falls on the neighbouring parcel, so it is not used.

census_address_geocode.service: address-range interpolation on TIGER line 633720662, left side, range 1 to 199

interpretation: The City of Greenville parcel layer gives 33 GLOBAL as parcel M011010100337, owned of record by DC BLOX INC since a deed recorded on 22 March 2021. The city's active address point for 33 GLOBAL DR and a city building footprint of about 27,000 sq ft (both last edited on 12 May 2022, a month after the facility's 12 April 2022 ribbon cutting) lie inside it. The parcel centroid therefore locates DC BLOX's Greenville property. DC BLOX's own schema.org pin lies 113 m to the east-north-east on the neighbouring parcel and the Census address-range point 371 m away; neither is used.
geocoder_role: U.S. Census Bureau Geocoder used only as a cross-check of street, place and county; its interpolated point is not the selected locator.
alternatives_rejected: Greenville County GIS (www.gcgis.org, gcgis.org): robots.txt requests failed at the network level, so no request was made.

Third-party ArcGIS Online copies of Greenville County parcels (captured agol-search-greenville-parcels.json) were not used; the City of Greenville's own service (owner account of the City GIS organisation) was used instead.
No OpenStreetMap, Nominatim, map-app, city centroid or county centroid was used.
